name: pikku-site-clone
description: Clone, copy or recreate an existing website faithfully (look, layout, colours, fonts, copy, pictures, menu, page structure): capture every page of the original from the rendered page (HTML, structure, layout of columns and pictures, screenshots at phone, laptop and large-screen widths, small tiles you can look at), build the layout first and then the style, and compare each page with the original after you build it. Also covers planning the work (what to file, in which order) when a brief names a site to rebuild or to free from outside services. Use whenever a request says to clone, copy, replicate, recreate or convert a site or page.

findings.excerpt: REF=artifacts/references/<site>        # <site> = the original's host name, e.g. www.the-site.example
mkdir -p $REF && pikku ui pages capture https://the-site.example/ --out $REF > $REF/capture.log 2>&1 &   # slow: a minute or two per page; carry on reading
pikku ui pages compare --reference $REF --page <page>   # every width in $REF; starts the app's dev server if it is not up
node $SC shot mine http://localhost:<port>/<path> --width 1440      # one page, one width: a screenshot and tiles, in seconds
node $SC check http://localhost:<port> $REF --page <page>          # one page, a few seconds
